api_newer.title: Lekto ({name}): update the integration
api_newer.description: Lekto {lekto_version} speaks version {api_version} of its API, newer than the version {integration_api} this integration speaks. Some numbers, events or actions may fail. Update the integration in the Marketplace; the repair goes once both fit.

api_older.title: Lekto ({name}): update Lekto
api_older.description: Lekto {lekto_version} speaks version {api_version} of its API, older than the version {integration_api} this integration speaks. Some numbers, events or actions may fail. Update Lekto where it runs; the repair goes once both fit.

api_unknown.title: Lekto ({name}): unreadable API version
api_unknown.description: Lekto {lekto_version} names its API version as {api_version}, which this integration cannot read; it speaks version {integration_api}. Some numbers, events or actions may fail. Update Lekto and the integration to their newest releases; the repair goes once both fit.

abort.issue_gone: The rights are back; nothing to remove.
abort.reauth_started: A new token was asked for; the repair goes once a token with the rights is set up.

init.title: Lekto ({name}): diagnostic entities off
init.description: Lekto's token no longer has the right {rights}, so the sensors of Lekto's jobs, search index and classifier and the update entity are off. Enter a new token that has the rights, or remove the entities that are gone with them.

remove_entities.title: Remove the entities
remove_entities.description: Remove the entities that need the rights from Home Assistant. The repair does not come back; a new token with the rights brings them back.

abort.issue_gone: The rights are back; nothing to remove.
abort.reauth_started: A new token was asked for; the repair goes once a token with the rights is set up.

init.title: Lekto ({name}): document events off
init.description: Lekto's token no longer has the rights {rights}, so the document event and the update of the numbers on each event are off. Enter a new token that has the rights, or remove the entities that are gone with them.

remove_entities.title: Remove the entities
remove_entities.description: Remove the entities that need the rights from Home Assistant. The repair does not come back; a new token with the rights brings them back.

abort.no_events: The token lacks the rights of the document event (documents:read and admin:documents_all), so there is nothing to pick.

init.title: Document event
init.description: Pick what the document event carries beside the document's id. With any field picked, the integration asks Lekto once per event for the document. The fields stay out of the recorder's history; the last event, with its fields, is kept across restarts.

data_description.event_fields: Contact, document type and tags need the right master_data:read; space needs spaces:read with admin:documents_all.
